system.notes:
One of three elementals bound to Stone (Alexander Cross), bound to him for Combat Spells.

No mechanical link to Stone. boundSpirits is a field on CharacterData and Stone is an npc, so the binding is recorded in prose on both sheets rather than faked with a link the data model cannot hold.

Services are 0 / unknown. The page gives an assignment, not a service count — GM sets this. No invented number is presented as printed.

Unlike the insects, these are real spirit actors: the system derives elemental attributes from Force per the SR2 Critter Statistics Table (p.234–235), which is correct here because Queen Euphoria prints no elemental attributes to preserve.

Queen Euphoria p.21.
